# Five Books, Twenty Readers

<!-- STEP id="setup" -->
The school library gets 5 copies of a new storybook. 20 students, Meera among them, want to read it.

<!-- STEP id="rules" -->
Who reads first? The library could go by first come, hold a lottery, let students share by turns, or buy more copies. Each rule changes who reads first.

<!-- STEP id="scarcity" -->
With 5 copies, only 5 students can read at one time, whatever the rule. Buying more copies lets more students read, but that money could buy something else.

**When wants are more than the things that can meet them, we call it scarcity. Scarcity forces us to choose.**
